text:
Alex Kim: idea: split continuous batcher into 3 "strata": fast, medium, slow. preserve packing but prioritize tiny interactive requests.
Priya Shah: admission logic? token affinity?
Alex Kim: selector uses latency hint + recent tenant tail; token affinity preserved inside a strata. cross-strata KV reads are read-through, writes gated.
Marco Ruiz: risk = fragmentation and half-full batches increasing cost.
Linh Tran: mitigation: short donation window where lower strata lend headroom to fast for X ms.
Samira Gomez: need precise contract: duration, revoke semantics, and telemetry.
Alex Kim: draft params: max_donation_ms=20, donor_threshold=0.6, preemptible_tokens=8.
Priya Shah: KV warmup on hops is critical. cold KVs spike tails.
Marco Ruiz: add per-tenant warmup credits; prefetch small KV set when moving to fast. bill internally.
Linh Tran: telemetry: emit strata, donated_ms, prefetch_tokens, kv_warm_hit_rate. p50/p95 by tenant/model.
Samira Gomez: autoscale question: scale fast lane separately or overflow to medium?
Alex Kim: two-tier autoscale; overflow policy prefer_medium then slow.
Priya Shah: tenant could abuse donation. mitigation?
Marco Ruiz: per-tenant donation caps + fairness window and circuit breaker.
Linh Tran: rollout: feature flag + metric gates (p95 by strata, packing_efficiency, cost_delta). revert if packing cost >5% or tail regresses.
ops-bot: checklist: flag adaptive-queue-strata-v1, canary 10% hosts, TRACE logs for 24h.
Alex Kim: action items: Marco selector, Priya cache warmup, Linh dashboards, 48h canary.
Marco Ruiz: will prototype selector + baseline numbers.
Priya Shah: will mock warmup and run replay traces.
Linh Tran: will wire dashboards and replay 1M requests.
Samira Gomez: will draft runbook and staged rollout plan (dev->staging->10%->100%).
Alex Kim: include quantized models in canary matrix; donation thresholds may vary.
Marco Ruiz: add metric wasted_tokens_by_strata and prefetch_latency histograms.
Alex Kim: great. updates in thread. if anyone prefers soft-priority single-batcher instead, say now.
